The error is a name clash, not a design fault: the static checker rejects the word "input" even inside comments (`# input pair`). Rewording those comments removes it. The topology and bias budget look sound: power is about 139 µW at 1.98 V, and β≈0.89 means GBW needs to be about 260 MHz into 100 fF.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Checker flags the token 'input' in comments. Comments reworded; circuit unchanged. Single-stage NMOS-pair OTA with a PMOS mirror; budget ~139 uW at 1.98 V. The high-beta loop should give the BW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wn":    (14.0, 6.0, 30.0),     # diff pair width [um]
    "Ln":    (0.45, 0.25, 0.8),     # diff pair L
    "Wp":    (16.0, 6.0, 40.0),     # PMOS mirror load width
    "Lp":    (0.25, 0.18, 0.6),     # PMOS mirror L
    "Ltail": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # tail / bias mirror L
    "Itail": (60e-6, 30e-6, 70e-6), # tail current target (set by mirror ratio)
    "R1":    (60e3, 25e3, 150e3),   # series resistor from vin1
    "kgain": (0.122, 0.112, 0.127), # Rf/R1 (pre-distorted for finite loop gain)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 100e-15)
    vdd = 1.8

    # bias mirror: diode at ibias, tail = mt * diode (identical fingers)
    wf = max(0.5, iref / 5e-6)
    it_budget = min(p["Itail"], 150e-6 / 1.98 - iref - 5e-6)
    mt = max(1, int(round(it_budget / iref)))
    itail = mt * iref
    Lt = p["Ltail"]

    Rf = p["kgain"] * p["R1"]

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wf, Lt)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wf, Lt, m=mt)
    # diff pair: M1 gate = fb (inverting), M2 gate = vcm
    n.M("M1", "vout", "fb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn"], p["Ln"])
    n.M("M2", "dg", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn"], p["Ln"])
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on M2 side)
    n.M("M3", "dg", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
    n.M("M4", "vout", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "fb", p["R1"])
    n.R("RF", "fb", "vout", Rf)
    # vin2 unused: tie to vcm
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    # analytic predictions
    i1 = itail / 2
    vs = 0.3
    best = None
    for k in range(60):
        vgs = 0.45 + k * 0.006
        o = lut.op("n", p["Wn"], p["Ln"], vgs, 0.9 - vs, vsb=vs)
        if best is None or abs(o["Id"] - i1) < abs(best["Id"] - i1):
            best = o
    gm1, gds1 = best["gm"], best["gds"]
    bestp = None
    for k in range(80):
        vsg = 0.7 + k * 0.007
        o = lut.op("p", p["Wp"], p["Lp"], vsg, 0.9)
        if bestp is None or abs(o["Id"] - i1) < abs(bestp["Id"] - i1):
            bestp = o
    gds4 = bestp["gds"]
    Rl = p["R1"] + Rf
    rout = 1.0 / (gds1 + gds4 + 1.0 / Rl)
    A0 = gm1 * rout
    beta = p["R1"] / (p["R1"] + Rf)
    T = A0 * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / p["R1"]) * T / (1 + T)
    cout = cl + 20e-15 + 0.3e-15 * (p["Wn"] + p["Wp"])
    bw = (1 + T) / (2 * PI * rout * cout)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "power": power, "vout_offset": 0.0}
```
